rule.description: Native synchronized stage attribution in O-M-C-C-M-O order. Separate from quiet timing; retain every output and log. No Torch profiler; output must remain admitted exact perarm. Inspect actual Omni diffuse calls and SGL synchronized stage/step boundaries before comparing denoise.

limitations: Native synchronized wall timers, not Torch Profiler. Instrumented E2E is retained but excluded from quiet latency and throughput claims.

SGLang DenoisingStage includes loop/scheduler and synchronous per-step timers. Omni native diffuse may be one full loop or 50 denoise_step calls; actual count is reported. With 50 calls, scheduler work outside denoise_step is excluded, so boundaries are not identical.
No inferred denoise time from default stage_gen_time_ms / steps.
Six measured samples per arm, all retained; no distributional confidence claim.
